item.tib: zhi khro rgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhi ba gsas mkhar rab 'byams kyi thugs sgrub nges don snying po
item.coloph: ces zhi ba gsas mkhar rab 'byams bder gshegs 'dus pa'i thugs sgrab nges don snying po 'di ni/ sems dpa' gsang sngags grags pa rin po che'i bka' yis bskul ngor/ shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams dge bshes rgyal po'i bstan 'dzin nor bu'i khab/ bshad sgrab bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug pa'i sa gnad 'dus sde chen po lhun grub dpag gling du/ snyigs dus kyi rnal 'byor pa 'ja' tshon snying pos/ hor zla gnyis pa'i 'phel phyogs su brtsams pa dge legs 'phel bar shog//
